exposure: conservative management of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
outcome: hysteroscopic findings (fine fibrous adhesions, niches, uterine adhesions, extensive fibrous scarring, endometrial polyps, incomplete healed scars, cervical stenosis, incomplete tubal ostia with soft tissue)
cohort: The study included 90 patients with morbidly adherent placenta who were managed conservatively at Ain Shams University Hospital.
finding: Conservative management of placenta accreta spectrum preserves uterine function in most cases, with fine fibrous adhesions being the most prevalent hysteroscopic abnormality.
